title: lappula macrantha
intro: Lappula macrantha, commonly known as Naked Orobanch, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Lappula macrantha include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and have a positive effect on cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Lappula macrantha include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
